distribution.narrative: Beaver & Liu (2010) directly confirms Taiwan occurrence of Crypturgus tuberosus from Nantou, Huison (18 March 2006).

host_note: Beaver & Liu (2010) reports Picea spp. and Pinus spp.; genus-level host resolution is retained.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Crypturgus tuberosus Niisima, 1909.

nomenclature_note: The current accepted identity is Crypturgus tuberosus Niisima, 1909, VSN_1933, Scolytinae: Crypturgini. Beaver & Liu (2010) uses the same species name and authorship Niisima.
